posts.trend: Fewer than 1 in 4 people with diabetes in India sustain diet advice for six months, experts say
posts.context: Indian parents are incapable of accepting a clinical diagnosis without passing moral judgment on your daily routine.
posts.angle: The family diagnoses your biological failures as character flaws caused by a lack of sunlight and early mornings.
slides: Your mother has a different explanation for your HbA1c.

"It is because of that phone."
"You are sleeping with the screen on."
"Try drinking warm water with lemon."
"Beta, your cousin Rohit runs five kilometers every morning."

Rohit is twenty-four.

He is currently on his third gap year.
posts.caption: Send this to the cousin whose morning routine is being used to humiliate you in the family group chat.
posts.rank_verdict: The term 'gap year' feels slightly too Westernized and privileged for a typical middle-class mother's comparative weapon, even if the comedic landing is brilliant.
